rationale: Most ground-truth concerns (rpc_routing fixture AttributeError, nan/inf validation, missing max_batch<=1 gate) are already fixed in the shown diff, so neither candidate gets credit for re-flagging them; the one substantive open item (hsliuustc0106's ask for __post_init__ invariant validation on the now-private _AdmissionWaitDecision) is only partially echoed by both via 'private type leaks into public hook signatures' (X point 5, Y finding 6), and neither proposes the actual invariant check. Both independently found the same real, well-verified bug (the 'wave_is_running' test is vacuous because max_num_seqs=1 hits the max_batch<=1 guard first) and the stable_since reset-order behavior change, with concrete file:line evidence and high actionability. Y edges ahead with a genuinely novel, on-theme catch (the omni_config.py projection mirror skips the finiteness check, delaying validation) and a more rigorously evidenced/structured format, while X's extra points (policy 'half-moved', dp_concurrent placement) are more speculative design opinions than concrete defects.
